headline: Approved $1,742,414.66 in Bond Series 2025 Requisition #3 payments for construction, design, and equipment invoices.
summary: The committee received updates on the high school, track and field, and dual language school projects. It approved $1,742,414.66 in bond payments to contractors and vendors. Bids for the dual language project are due August 12, 2026.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the July 8, 2026 meeting. Two members abstained, and the rest voted in favor.
Approved payment of $1,742,414.66 in Bond Series 2025 Requisition #3 invoices, all in favor.

decision_evidence.quote: A. DeBurgo made a motion to approve the minutes as presented, seconded by A. Lynch ... Abstentions: Hannah Rivers, Matt Jerzyk All in favor
A Lynch made a motion to approve the School Bond Series 2025 #3 for $1,742,414.66. H. Rivers seconded the motion. No Discussion All In Favor
